name: Yashio (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yashio city emblem in red: a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yashio, a city in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 17 September 1964.

features.role: Yashio city emblem — a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
